title: Regular closed immersion with sourcewise codimension function
statement: Let $i:Y\to X$ be a morphism of schemes [def-pc-scheme] and let $c:|Y|\to\mathbb N$. We say that $i$ is a regular closed immersion with codimension function $c$ if it is a closed immersion [def-weil-closed-immersion] and, for every $y\in Y$, there are an affine open neighbourhood $U$ of $i(y)$ and a finite list $a$ of sections in $\Gamma(U,\mathcal O_X)$ of length $c(y)$ which is a regular sequence [def-weil-pbc-regular-sequence] and generates the kernel of $\Gamma(U,\mathcal O_X)\to\Gamma(i^{-1}U,\mathcal O_Y)$. The function may vary on the source; the length zero and empty source are allowed. Local constancy and equality with conormal rank are theorems, not defining hypotheses.
